jobs.description:
**Department:** Implementation
  
  
Job Description
  
  
You have experience working in marketing or creative operations, with an understanding of the tools and challenges that creative and design teams face. You are a natural teacher and coach with a passion for project management: you love helping customers get comfortable with new software and celebrating when it clicks for them.
  
  
You are design-literate and unintimidated by production and templating tools. You understand how production designers think, you can find your way around Adobe InDesign, and you are eager to learn a technical templating toolset quickly and then teach it clearly to others. When something does not work the way a customer expects, you enjoy digging in to figure out why.
  
  
You’re curious about AI and comfortable using it day-to-day for drafting, research, and scaling your work. You’re excited to help customers adopt AI features with the same clarity and coaching mindset you’d bring to any other part of the platform.
  
  
You bring tenacity, patience, and a genuine passion for people. You partner with customers to ensure their goals and outcomes are met through the onboarding journey across Lytho’s platform, and you have a passion for creating content and training that educates at scale.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations at varying stages, prioritizing across competing deadlines and TTV commitments.
  
  
Partner with our new and existing customers to ensure successful training and adoption of Lytho’s solution.
  
  
Train customers’ designers to build their own design templates. Troubleshoot customer template issues (for example font and style conflicts, frame problems, and export settings).
  
  
Deliver professional services engagements as scoped, including customized product configuration, staff augmentation, or supplemental onsite training and enablement.
  
  
Work with Sales and Customer Experience to understand and document customers’ goals and desired outcomes; facilitate a smooth post-sale transition for new customers from initial product access to launch.
  
  
Understand customers’ desired outcomes to develop a customized onboarding plan and project manage customer onboarding based on the plan specifics.
  
  
Maintain a strong working knowledge of the product as an internal product Subject Matter Expert (SME). Work with internal resources to drive forward technical feature fulfillment and proactively identify additional product needs.
  
  
Thrive in a fast-moving product environment and proactively identify risks while partnering with Customer Experience to mitigate and resolve onboarding or training hurdles throughout the customer lifecycle.
  
  
Become the voice of the customer, helping the Product Development team identify bugs and product improvements based on the requirements and preferences of the customer.
  
  
Create and contribute to customer-facing training content such as videos, webinars, documents, and Knowledge Base articles.
  
  
Deliver training and presentations to large-scale audiences to support customer events.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**What We Look For:**  
2+ years of experience in marketing or creative operations with an understanding of the tools and challenges that designers face.
  
  
2+ years of experience in customer onboarding or training in a software environment.
  
  
Design and production literacy (typography, color, print and digital output formats) plus working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and comfort teaching design and production best practices (preflight, fonts, paragraph and character styles, export settings), with the willingness and aptitude to deepen into templating.
  
  
Digital Asset Management (DAM) experience with a taxonomy background is a plus.
  
  
Previous project management experience and demonstrated time management skills.
  
  
Comfort using AI tools in your own workflow and a willingness to coach customers through adopting AI features.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to learn technical software quickly and then teach it clearly to varied audiences and learning styles.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across different levels in a customer’s organization, using diplomacy and tact to defuse difficult conversations.
  
  
Excellent, enthusiastic, and friendly communication and outreach skills, responding rapidly to customer inquiries, and drafting concise and informative emails.
  
  
Outstanding organizational, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
  
  
We recruit from many locations in the U.S., our preferred location in the U.S. is North Carolina and the surrounding states for easy access. Currently, we are not hiring candidates who reside and work from outside of the United States as well as OH, WA, CA, NH, HI, CT and Chicago, IL, due to legal and business registration reasons.
  
  
**Who We Are:**  
We are a growing, global software company that is obsessed with helping brand and creative teams do better work. We started as the first online proofing solution and evolved to a full creative operations platform. We’re a remote-first company with employees working from home across the United States and the Netherlands. We have a drop-in workspace in Raleigh, North Carolina where we can collaborate and maintain personal connections as needed. We are a group of passionate, curious, and unique individuals who value transparency and continuous development.
  
Why Become a Lythonian?
  
  
We know that our people are what make us great! We continue to invest in resources and programs to support the wellbeing and growth of each Lythonian, both professionally and personally.
  
  
**Benefits:** We offer diverse benefits to support the health, wellbeing, and futures of our people and their loved ones, including: unlimited PTO; paid parental leave; paid gender transition leave; “Summer Fridays” (half-days on Fridays during the summer months); medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and accident insurance; EAP services; and 401K with match.
  
  
**Remote Work & Flexibility:** We are a “Remote First” workplace, where Lythonians have the flexibility and autonomy to balance work and personal needs. We care about the work you deliver, not the hours you spend online.
  
  
**Room for Growth:** We love to see our team grow and thrive! In our current stage of rapid growth, there are plenty of opportunities to develop in your career and/or learn new skills.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion:** We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We are a diverse group with people from all over the world, and our priority is to foster a safe and welcoming environment for all. We have a dedicated committee that focuses on diversity, equity, and inclusion at Lytho and have implemented initiatives such as creating a gender transition leave policy and including Juneteenth as a company holiday.
  
  
**EEO + Accessibility:**  
Lytho is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, as we know that diverse characteristics, backgrounds, thought processes, and viewpoints lead to innovation and growth! We are committed to fostering a safe and inclusive environment for all Lythonians to bring their authentic selves. If you need assistance or reasonable accommodation, please contact Human Resources at questions@lytho.com

Position Description: Implementation Engineer (Contractor) – FactoryLogix MES

Aegis Software | Independent Contractor (1099) | Remote, United States

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

Aegis Software is engaging experienced independent contractors to deliver FactoryLogix MES implementations for manufacturing customers, as demand for our software implementations grows. You'll act as the technical consultant on projects you accept: configuring, installing, deploying and integrating Aegis software so it meets the customer's business requirements and runs smoothly in their infrastructure or on a pre-configured cloud instance. Engagements cover the whole implementation lifecycle, from needs assessment and planning through go-live and handoff to support.

This engagement is for an independent, self-directed professional. You decide how and when the work gets done, solve complex deployment problems as they arise, and are accountable for results against each project's scope documents and success criteria.

**ENGAGEMENT TERMS**

Structure: Individual independent contractor (1099). A signed W-9 is required before work starts.

**Length:** Ongoing, reviewed annually by both parties.

**Hours:** No fixed or minimum hours. Work is offered based on project demand, and you choose which projects to accept.

**Location:** Remote, anywhere in the United States. Customer site visits as projects require.

**Travel:** Up to 50% on accepted projects. Reasonable travel expenses are reimbursable as set out in the contractor agreement.

**Rate:** $/per billable hour based on experience

**Invoicing:** Monthly invoice for hours delivered, supported by the billable hours recorded in Aegis's project system. Payment terms per the contractor agreement.

**Agreement:** All terms are governed by a written Independent Contractor Agreement. (ICA)

**Scope of Work**

On each accepted project, deliverables are defined in the project's scope documents. Typical deliverables include:

* Customer requirements: Work with customer executives and end users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into system configurations.
* Installation and configuration: Install, configure and tailor the software to the customer's workflows, in line with the project's business goals.
* Integration and readiness: Integrate the software with the customer's existing systems. Before deployment, provide clear guidance so validation and testing are completed ahead of rollout.
* Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues during and after implementation. When an issue can't be resolved right away, document the work done, collect logs and enter clear ticket notes so it can be driven to resolution.
* End-user training: Deliver training built around real-world scenarios so users retain what they learn and adopt the system. Aegis training materials are available; you may adapt them to the customer's workflows.
* Documentation: Produce implementation checklists, user guides, quick-start guides, meeting agendas and similar project materials. Submit activity reports of completed work for customer sign-off.
* Project coordination: Coordinate with the Aegis Project Manager assigned to each project on milestones, deliverables and handoff to support. Technical escalations go to Aegis lead implementation engineers.
* Billable time records: Record billable hours and reimbursable expenses in Aegis's project system so Aegis can invoice its customers.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years in software implementation, MES/ERP deployment or related technical consulting, including at least two full-lifecycle MES implementations
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (queries, scripts)
* Experience deploying to or administering cloud environments (Azure or AWS)
* Experience integrating MES with ERP systems and shop-floor equipment
* Strong troubleshooting skills: able to analyze system issues and determine how to resolve them
* Excellent written and spoken communication with customers and internal teams
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into technical solutions
* Proven ability to deliver independently with minimal oversight
* Able to travel up to 50% on accepted projects

**Preferred**

* Hands-on FactoryLogix experience
* Background in electronics (SMT/PCBA) or discrete manufacturing
* Familiarity with machine connectivity standards
* Prior independent contracting or consulting experience

* Work from anywhere – Roles are open to candidates located anywhere in the US (United States)

* Strong organizational and communication skills.

* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, systems, and processes quickly.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to accuracy in system configuration, validation, and documentation.
* Proven problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate implementation challenges effectively.
* Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to solve business challenges and improve customer outcomes.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Support - Brand Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing**

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.  
  
ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.  
  
At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Manager, Brand Onboarding to join our Product Support team. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll run your own mixed Shopify and non-Shopify onboarding queue, take point on our most complex and escalated brands, and make the onboarding playbook sharper every month. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Brand Onboarding.

You'll own a defined slice of the onboarding experience end-to-end, from post-sale through go-live. Expect roughly 70% of your time in the queue and 30% on projects that reduce friction for brands and for the team. **This role is remote and works Eastern Time business hours, with flexibility to support brand launches as needed.**

**Your Impact In The Role**
---------------------------

* Manage a mixed Shopify and non-Shopify onboarding queue, getting every brand live quickly with clear kickoffs, proactive updates, and no surprises
* Guide brands through technical setup (integrations, tracking, catalog, and payment configuration), resolving blockers within onboarding before they delay launch or become support tickets
* Proactively drive stalled and unresponsive brands forward, keeping account notes current so status is always clear
* Act as the escalation point for Senior Associates and set the quality bar for troubleshooting and brand communication
* Own onboarding initiatives end-to-end, using data and trends to reduce friction, time-to-go-live, and repeat escalations
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS on known issues and platform improvements that affect brand launches
* Build and continuously improve the checklists, docs, and workflows the team relies on, using AI tools to cut manual lift

**You Are Energized By**
------------------------

* Rolling up your sleeves on a tricky onboarding and seeing it through to launch
* Finding the root cause, not just the fix, and making sure it doesn't happen again
* Turning messy processes into clean checklists and docs your teammates actually use
* Direct feedback and evolving processes; you own mistakes openly and adjust quickly
* Being the person peers and cross-functional partners trust to get it done
* Fast-moving, high-growth environments where priorities shift and adaptability is a strength

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 3 to 5 years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, client success, or a related role
* Experience in e-commerce and/or affiliate marketing; hands-on Shopify experience strongly preferred
* Proven ability to manage a portfolio of accounts at once, balancing urgency, quality, and relationships
* Experience handling escalated or high-touch accounts, ideally Enterprise or Premium brands
* Root-cause and systems thinking: you ask why, not just what
* Communicates credibly with Product and Engineering on technical issues
* Comfortable using data and trends to make the case for process changes
* Strong written and verbal communication with brands and internal teams
* Sound judgment balancing speed, accuracy, and risk on high-stakes accounts

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
* Familiarity with Intercom, Salesforce, or similar support and CRM tooling
* Knowledge of the creator economy, influencer marketing, or affiliate platforms
* Experience working with AI tools (e.g., Fin AI, Claude, or similar) and shaping how they're used in a workflow

*The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission, and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!*

**Benefits & Perks**

ShopMy invests in more than compensation. We support your health, your growth, and your life outside of work.

* **Equity in ShopMy** - Every employee is an owner; all roles receive equity
* **Monetize Your Influence** - Every employee builds and grows their own ShopMy page
* **401(k) with Company Match** - 3% employer contribution, fully vested
* **Healthcare Coverage** - Medical, dental & vision benefits, including a 100% employer-paid medical option and dependent coverage

MTSI is seeking a Digital Engineering Training Specialist. As a Digital Engineering Training Specialist you will work on the Workforce Development team, under Technical Training. Your tasking will consist of all aspects of Digital Engineering course development and instruction, to include identification of needed training, outlines, resource creation (slides, self-paced tutorials, surveys, videos, and other reference material), team reviews and feedback incorporation. This position requires the applicant to be an articulate, and confident presenter to provide instruction and overviews, to include multiple venues (Live Webinar, On-Site, and Recordings).

In this role, you will use your experience as an engineering professional to convey informative and accurate Digital Engineering course content, respond to Q&A from students and be prepared to provide insightful anecdotes during class. The applicant should have a wide variety of experience with Digital Engineering tools and processes and be familiar with industry standards and emerging technologies and trends. This position will require interfacing with students and project leads, which could be internal or external. This position may require some travel to external customer sites.

* SysML V2 (Fundamentals, Practitioners, Methodology)

* Digital Twin/Digital Thread
* Other DE Technical Courses

* MBSE Concepts, Tools, & Methodologies
* MBSE Concepts

* This position is fully remote
* This position may require some travel (up to 10%)

* Applicants must be US Citizens and should be able to receive a Secret Clearance
